mapper.sql: select p.id, p.task_name, p.status, p.original_file_name, p.stored_file_path, p.source_text, p.result_json, p.entity_count, p.llm_model, p.completed_time, p.error_message, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, kv.id as knowledge_version_id, kit.id as knowledge_ingest_task_id, kit.progress as knowledge_progress, kit.current_stage as knowledge_stage, kit.error_message as knowledge_error_message, kit.finished_time as knowledge_finished_time, case when kv.id is null then 'UNPUBLISHED' when kit.status = '0' then 'QUEUED' when kit.status = '1' then 'PUBLISHING' when kit.status = '3' or kv.status = '3' then 'FAILED' when kit.status = '2' or (kv.status = '2' and kb.current_version_id = kv.id) then 'PUBLISHED' else 'UNPUBLISHED' end as knowledge_status from business_data_pdf p left join business_kb_version kv on kv.id = ( select v.id from business_kb_version v inner join business_knowledge source on source.id = v.source_id where source.source_code = concat('DATA-PDF-', p.id) order by v.id desc limit 1 ) left join business_knowledge kb on kb.id = kv.source_id left join business_kb_ingest_task kit on kit.id = ( select t.id from business_kb_ingest_task t where t.version_id = kv.id order by t.id desc limit 1 )
